| colspan="10" align="left" style="width:50px"| '''Notes:'''{{refbegin}}{{note|necklace|1}} A Hidden Immunity Necklace was played; however, no votes were cast against its user.<br />{{note|duel|2}} Since the Kadasi tribe lost the Reward, the first two members to fall during the challenge competed in a Duel. The loser was immediately eliminated.<br />{{note|necklace2|3}} A Hidden Immunity Necklace was played, negating all votes against its user.<br />{{note|ambassadors|4}} At the ambassadors meeting, the two ambassadors agreed to vote Ricky out of the game.<br />{{note|final12|5}} The castaway who finished last in the ninth Immunity Challenge would be eliminated from the game. Océane came in last and was eliminated.<br />{{note|tieddestinies|6}} Aurélien was Sébastien's partner during the Tied Destinies twist, therefore he was also eliminated when Sébastien was voted out.<br />{{note|duel|7}} On Day 33, a duel occurred between Aurélien and Sébastien to reenter the game to replace Jean. Sébastien won and reentered the game.<br />{{note|tie|8}} The vote resulted in a tie. Per ''Koh-Lanta'' rules, a revote was held.<br />{{note|final5|9}} At the final five, the remaining castaways competed in an elimination challenge. Amri and Pauline came in last and were eliminated.<br />{{refend}}
